name: Joshua Jackson
bio: Joshua Carter Jackson (born June 11, 1978) is a Canadian actor. He has appeared in primetime television and in over 32 film roles. He is best known for playing Charlie Conway in The Mighty Ducks film series, Pacey Witter in the television series Dawson's Creek (1998-2003), Peter Bishop in the television series Fringe (2008-2013) and Cole Lockhart in the television series The Affair (2014-2019).
